CLI and Firefox desktop host packages for Linux, Windows, and macOS.

Since `alpha-0.0.2`, the CLI has gained direct Iroh invites, saved peer IDs,
reconnection, and automatic transfer continuation. This release also introduces
the Firefox desktop add-on and its native host.

Extract the archive for your platform. Run the CLI directly or copy it to your
`PATH`. Run the included `install-firefox-host` script to register the native
host before installing the Firefox add-on.

Install the signed Firefox add-on from
https://addons.mozilla.org/firefox/addon/rustytransfer/ or download the signed
XPI attached to this release.
